_readme: Completed seasons only, oldest first. Filled at the end of each season by tools/build_history.py (from Sleeper), or by hand. The season in progress is never listed here; the site adds it from live data. Per team: gm = the GM's Sleeper user ID (the key that follows a GM between franchises), gmName = display name at the time, division = Sleeper division number. champion / runnerUp = roster_id. divisionWinners = roster_ids. weeklyHigh = [{week, points, rosters}] (a tie lists every roster and splits the prize). pointsLeader = roster_ids with the most regular-season points. prizes = that season's prize amounts, copied from league.json when the season is first written. gmOfYear = roster_id of the league-vote winner: the commissioner types it in after the vote (null until then); reruns keep it. Career earnings on the site are computed from these fields.
